slug: 根骨被毁我逆袭成准帝
lines: 天武元年十一月初六，南梁国都。
涂山府坐落于南梁都城南郊的南屏山，黛瓦飞檐顺着山势层叠铺开，青石板阶从府门蜿蜒至山坳。府门两侧的玄铁狮是一千年前的旧物，乃是涂山老祖辅佐南梁第一任皇帝称霸天下时所铸。虽经风雨侵蚀，鬃毛的纹路仍清晰如昔。
贵妃涂山玉骑马疾驰而来，临近府门时，直接弃马飞身而下。
涂山府内，南梁皇孟绥在两名亲随的搀扶下缩在回廊角落里。在他身前，十道黑影站成一排，如鬼魅一般立在回廊边缘。
院子中央，涂山府的所有人被坚韧的蜘蛛丝捆得结结实实，堵住嘴巴，横七竖八地堆在一起。
“孟绥，南梁涂山氏所有人都在这里了？”庄拓点了点人数，一双冰冷阴鸷的眼眸朝角落里的孟绥看过去。
孟绥浑身一颤，哆哆嗦嗦回答：“回庄上使，南梁涂山氏共九百三十口，都在这里了。”
“谅你也不敢欺瞒！”
庄拓冷哼一声，耳边垂着的两条青蛇示威一般钻出斗篷。
“涂山玉是哪一个？”庄拓又问。
孟绥顿时汗流浃背，他颤颤巍巍抬起手，指着人堆里的涂山薇。
涂山薇死死地瞪着回廊角落里，缩成一团，连头都不敢抬起的孟绥，到底是没有出声反驳。
她心里隐隐有些后悔，不该托人送信物给涂山玉。大昭来的这位庄上使修为高深，怕是已经到了圣王境，还带着九个妖族帮手，整个涂山氏九百三十人联手都不是他们的对手。涂山玉来了也改变不了什么，保下她还能给她们报仇。
庄拓顺着孟绥指的方向看过去，见人堆里坐着一位明艳大气的美貌妇人，身上穿着石青翟衣，肩头披着霞帔，头上梳着高高的云髻，正中央插着一支口衔东珠的凤钗，旁侧点缀着三排珠翠。
这般耀眼夺目，华贵端庄的美人定是南梁贵妃涂山玉无疑了！
庄拓心中再无怀疑。
见庄拓看过来，目光阴鸷中带着审视，两条青蛇在他肩头吞吐着蛇信，涂山薇只觉得毛骨悚然，连呼吸都僵住了。
“全部杀了，不留一个活口！”
突然，庄拓冷声开口。
院中的空气像是凝固了一般，连风都吹不进来。站在回廊边缘的九道黑影身上瞬间散发出杀气，他们齐齐抬脚走向院中央。
庄拓立在原地，目光扫过面前瑟瑟发抖的人群，眼底没有一丝怜悯。涂山薇面色一白，紧紧闭上双眼。缩在回廊角落里的孟绥直接吓破了胆，他一脸惶恐，软软地瘫坐在地上，他身旁的亲随也吓得面色如土。
“动手！”
庄拓再次开口，这一次的声音带着威压。
话音刚落，九道黑影凶神恶煞地扑过去，妖影幢幢，将阳光搅动的支离破碎。惨叫声此起彼伏，在九道黑影单方面的屠杀下，院中的涂山氏一族众人心中只剩下无助和绝望。
涂山玉便是在这时候冲入院中，她一眼就看到如待宰的羔羊一般被九道黑影残忍屠杀的涂山氏族人。她的姐姐涂山薇被一只熊妖掐住了脖子；她的侄儿被一只猪妖一口吞入腹中；她的叔伯被一只蜘蛛妖咬掉了半边身子……
“住手！”
涂山玉目眦尽裂，她怒吼一声，闪身来到熊妖跟前，一掌劈碎了他的头颅，然后将面如白纸的涂山薇抱入怀中。
“玉儿……快逃……你不是他们的对手！”涂山薇呼吸微弱，她吃力地吐出最后几个字便气绝而亡。
content_en:
On the sixth day of the eleventh month of the first year of Tianwu, it was the capital of Nanliang.
Tushan Mansion is located in Nanping Mountain on the southern outskirts of Nanliang Capital City. The black-tiled eaves are spread out in layers along the mountain, and the bluestone steps wind from the mansion gate to the mountain col. The black iron lions on both sides of the palace gate are old things from a thousand years ago. They were made by the Tushan ancestor when he assisted the first emperor of Nanliang to dominate the world. Although eroded by wind and rain, the texture of the mane is still as clear as ever.
The imperial concubine Tu Shanyu came galloping on horseback. When she approached the gate of the mansion, she abandoned her horse and flew down.
In Tushan Mansion, Emperor Meng Sui of Nanliang huddled in the corner of the corridor with the support of two personal attendants. In front of him, ten black figures stood in a row, standing like ghosts on the edge of the corridor.
In the center of the courtyard, everyone in the Tushan Mansion was tied tightly with tough spider silk, their mouths were gagged, and they were piled up in a mess.
"Meng Sui, are all the Tushan clan members in Nanliang here?" Zhuang Tuo counted the number of people and looked at Meng Sui in the corner with a pair of cold and sinister eyes.
Meng Sui trembled all over, and replied tremblingly: "Return to the village to envoy, a total of 930 members of the Tushan clan in Nanliang are here."
"I'm sorry you don't dare to lie!"
Zhuang Tuo snorted coldly, and the two green snakes hanging by his ears came out of the cloak as if to demonstrate.
"Which Tushan jade is it?" Zhuang Tuo asked again.
Meng Sui was suddenly sweating profusely. He raised his hand tremblingly and pointed at Tu Shanwei in the crowd.
"She..."
Tu Shanwei stared at Meng Sui, who was huddled in a ball in the corner of the corridor, not even daring to raise his head, but did not utter a word to refute.
She felt a little regretful that she shouldn't have asked someone to send a token to Tu Shanyu. The Zhuang Shang envoy who came from Dazhao had a high level of cultivation. He was probably at the Holy King level. He also brought nine demon clan helpers. The entire Tushan clan's 930 people together were no match for them. Tu Shanyu's arrival won't change anything, but she can still avenge them if she is saved.
Zhuang Tuo looked in the direction Meng Sui pointed and saw a bright and beautiful woman sitting in the crowd. She was wearing an azure robe, a Xia pei on her shoulders, and a high bun on her head. In the center was a phoenix hairpin with an east pearl in its mouth, and three rows of pearls on the sides.
Such a dazzling, luxurious and dignified beauty must be Tushan Jade, the noble concubine of Nanliang!
Zhuang Tuo no longer had any doubts in his mind.
Seeing Zhuang Tuo looking over, with a sinister and scrutinizing look in his eyes, and two green snakes swallowing snake messages on his shoulders, Tu Shanwei felt horrified and even froze in breathing.
"Kill them all, leaving no one alive!"
Suddenly, Zhuang Tuo spoke coldly.
The air in the courtyard seemed to be frozen, not even the wind could blow in. The nine black figures standing at the edge of the corridor instantly exuded murderous aura, and they all walked toward the center of the courtyard.
Zhuang Tuo stood on the spot, his eyes scanning the trembling crowd in front of him, without a trace of pity in his eyes. Tu Shanwei's face turned pale and she closed her eyes tightly. Meng Sui, who was huddled in the corner of the corridor, was frightened out of his wits. He had a look of fear on his face and slumped down on the ground. The people beside him also looked pale with fear.
"Do it!"
Zhuang Tuo spoke again, this time his voice was coercive.
As soon as he finished speaking, nine black shadows rushed towards him fiercely. The shadows stirred up the sunlight and shattered it into pieces. Screams were heard one after another. Under the one-sided massacre by the nine black shadows, the Tushan clan in the courtyard were left with nothing but helplessness and despair in their hearts.
It was at this time that Tu Shanyu rushed into the courtyard. She saw at a glance the Tushan clan members who were being brutally slaughtered by nine black shadows like lambs waiting to be slaughtered. Her sister Tu Shanwei was choked by a bear demon; her nephew was swallowed by a pig demon; her uncle was bitten off by a spider demon...
"Stop!"
Tu Shanyu's eyes were all cracked. She roared angrily, walked up to the bear demon, chopped his head into pieces with one palm, and then took Tu Shanwei, whose face was as white as paper, into her arms.
"Yu'er... run away... you are no match for them!" Tu Shanwei's breathing was weak, and she breathed out the last few words with difficulty before dying.
